metadataScope: Complete current uploads, article titles, category metadata and file-category members; all file-usage records joined to current main article IDs. No assertion that all3937 images were viewed.
animatedFiles: Still browser-frame review only; not every animation frame.

observations.silhouettes: Role, headgear, held equipment and posture distinguish human combatants. Large animals use long torso/hock/muzzle silhouettes rather than fitting a whole body inside one tiny square.
observations.materialClusters: Small selected highlights and broken clusters describe fur, wool, leather and iron. Cloth seams, edge wear and restrained metal highlights remain readable at native scale.
observations.inventory: Long weapons and tools preserve a tall aspect ratio; armor uses a broader torso silhouette. A universal square display suppresses their detail.
observations.portraits: Faces differ through age planes, brow/nose/jaw/hair and headwear. Larger pixel portraits need separate authored anatomy, not an enlarged body sprite.
observations.environment: Vertical objects stand over the floor and use shared ground contact. Floor/wall material masses and narrow highlights keep figures readable.
observations.adaptation: ASHVEIL keeps its own adult proportions, ash palette, living patients and machine setting. Reference source pixels, named characters and proprietary silhouettes are not installed.

pending: The complete Enemies index includes uncategorized files beyond the Enemy NPC image category; additional index images and article-category routing are being audited. New ASHVEIL art and actual-game review remain in progress.
